text:
mike_p: Heads up — AcmeEdge wants to flip to live next Mon. They27re currently pushing hourly CSV files to our S3. We27d prefer signed webhooks but can we do a controlled CSV pilot? Need to confirm exact ingestion contract (manifest format, signature verification, timestamp timezone, row idempotency, SKU -> billing dimension mapping, and how to surface problems to ops).

sara_pm: I'm fine with a pilot but only if we run it in shadow (no billing) for 10 business days and require a signed manifest that lists filenames + HMAC. We should also require a small set of negative test files (missing cols, dup rows, out-of-order timestamps).

raj_eng: Engineering notes: we need deterministic file names (YYYYMMDD-HH-partner.csv) and a manifest.json that lists each file and includes an X-Manifest-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256). Row schema must include: partner_id, sku_id, usage_epoch_utc, quantity, unit, row_id. If row_id not provided we compute sha256(row_payload) as row_id. Use epoch seconds in UTC; no offsets. Sample row: ACME123,EDGE-XL,1713451200,1,device-minutes,row-0001

Also include an example verification command:
openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$PARTNER_SECRET" manifest.json | awk '{print $2}'

If manifest missing or signature invalid we should fail ingestion and alert ops.

jess_ops: Billing side: some SKUs are "seat" (need seat_count) others are "device_minutes" or "requests". Propose we store a partner_sku_mapping table with columns: sku_id, billing_dimension, required_fields. If a required field is absent (e.g., seat_count for seat SKU) mark the row as STALE/NEED_RECON and do not auto-invoice. We should also define proration for partial hours (round up device-minutes to nearest minute, seat proration by UTC day).

anna_legal: Legal: include retention & audit language in SOW: keep raw CSV+manifest for 12 months, audit logs for 3 years. Require pseudonymization of any customer PII. Also need indemnity language if partner supplies corrupted usage that causes misbilling.

mike_p: Owners: Raj -> ingestion spec + example good/bad files, Sara -> acceptance checklist & shadow run definition, Jess -> sku mapping doc & nightly recon job design, Anna -> SOW redline. Timeline?

sara_pm: I can deliver acceptance checklist and shadow run steps by EOD tomorrow. Checklist will include: duplicate row detection, late-arrival tolerance (48h), DST test cases, empty files handling, and a CSV->webhook converter script for partner local testing.

raj_eng: I27ll put up the manifest schema and 3 sample file sets (clean, dupes, corrupt rows) by today + 6 hours. Monitoring signals I want: partner.ingest.latency, partner.parse.errors, partner.duplicate.rows, partner.missing.manifest.

jess_ops: I27ll build the sku mapping stub and a reconciliation playbook: nightly job to move UNKNOWN rows to ops-staging, automated notification + sla for manual review (24h). Also add a charge-hold toggle to prevent accidental billing while pilot is active.

deploy-bot: scheduled: partner-ingest-shadow -> tomorrow 08:00 PST against staging cluster.

mike_p: Perfect. Can everyone confirm those deadlines? Planning a 30m signoff Thurs 10am to approve the pilot window and messaging to AcmeEdge.

sara_pm: Confirmed.

raj_eng: Confirmed.

jess_ops: Confirmed.

anna_legal: Confirmed, will upload redline to the drive by EOW.

mike_p: I'll notify AcmeEdge to delay go-live until pilot signoff complete. Thanks all.
